page.overview:
What is Artisia?

Artisia was the capital planet of House Taligari, where both the Senate and the Ingravid Opera were located.

A general meeting in the Senate took place in Artisia after the attack of the Sardaukar against Zanovar, where Glax Othn, who acted as spokesman of House Taligari, was murdered along with 14 million people.
